ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Online class discussion sessions will be held weekly in the Elluminate course delivery system. Online scheduled class sessions require that each student have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. No textbook required. The tuition rate for this section is $277 per credit hour. All students in this section will also be assessed a $45 per credit hour administration fee. These per credit hour assessments are not included in campus range assessments.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign or Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $277.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $45.00 per Bill Hour.
